defects.justification: Forwarded events are signed with the same WEBHOOK_SECRET shared with the payment provider; for merchants to verify them they must hold that secret, which then lets any merchant forge valid provider webhooks (e.g. payment.succeeded for any merchant). Needs a per-merchant signing key.

The server POSTs to callback URLs with no restriction on loopback/private/link-local/metadata addresses, and delivery_status/tries exposes reachability; anyone holding the admin token (or a mis-set URL) can make it hit internal services. README acknowledges; still needs egress filtering.

Signature covers only the body with no timestamp/nonce, so a captured request can be replayed; dedupe on event id limits this to events whose id is not yet stored (e.g. after DB loss or for intercepted-but-undelivered events). README acknowledges; low.
json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(out) error is ignored in handleListEvents, so failed/partial responses go unlogged.
